mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_task (task_name, export_type, file_format, status, total_rows, processed_rows, progress, file_path, file_name, file_size, filter_params, user_id, username, error_message, retry_count) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{exportType}, #{fileFormat}, #{status}, #{totalRows}, #{processedRows}, #{progress}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{filterParams}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM export_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE export_task SET processed_rows = #{processedRows}, progress = #{progress}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE export_task SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE export_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', file_path = #{filePath}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_size = #{fileSize}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, processed_rows = #{totalRows}, progress = 100, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE export_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM export_task WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at < #{expireTime} ORDER BY completed_at ASC
